conditions: Static even square side n>=2, both dimension orders, one fully populated physical minor tile of width 1 or 2 per layout, fixed same-width cells, ordinary non-host memory, successful tiling checks and new layout acceptance. Old raw bitcast(s) preserve cell buffer. No allocation/effects or native reachability claim.
types: Arbitrary cell payloads; equality of every final physical address Fin(n*n).
lhs: Copy between operand layouts, preserve cells in the intervening bitcast(s), then copy from the bitcast output layout to the final layout.
rhs: If bitcast and source tile widths agree, move the bitcast to x and copy from its mapped layout. Otherwise, if old copy and final tile widths agree, copy x to the inverse-mapped layout and bitcast that storage directly.
overlap: Reuses CopyChain.copy and its bounded layout representation. New terminal instantiates both directional dimension maps and the distinct tile-success branches. A pure untiled copy-composition theorem cannot select the second arm.
